labels.reason: The body reports group-summary parameters for unlabeled meropenem administered IV once daily for 14 days. These support partial identity, regimen, biological-context and summary-metadata matches. They do not establish individual observations or individual variability. Concentration curves are described as available only in Fig. 3 and not digitized; this page supplies no concentration-time records. AUC units conflict between the table and note, and its integration window is unspecified. Day columns have row-specific units: AUC (µg·min/ml), T1/2 (min), and C0 (mg/ml); no single column-wide unit is stated. IV bolus versus infusion, total versus unbound basis, dose formulation basis, actual body weights, sampling structure, assay limits and parameter-estimation methods are NOT_FOUND.

evidence.quote: Female dogs n = 3, unlabeled meropenem 120 mg/kg IV once daily for 14 days; plasma sampled at set times after the day 1 and day 14 doses. Each value mean ± SE of 3 dogs. Concentration curves for days 1 and 14 are in Fig. 3 only (not digitized).
Units as printed: the table gives AUC in µg·min/ml and C0 in mg/ml; the text gives AUC as 34.1 and 27.9 mg·min/ml and T1/2 42 and 45 min.

findings.reason: A69 specifies AUC (µg·min/ml), with B69 and C69 reporting 34.1 ± 1.6 and 27.9 ± 1.1. A67 instead gives AUC as 34.1 and 27.9 mg·min/ml. Preserve both statements without conversion or adoption of either unit. The note also repeats the table's T1/2 numerical values, but does not explicitly assign its individual text values to days.
findings.needed_material: Human review of the cited original Table 4 and surrounding text to resolve AUC units and confirm the day assignments of textual parameter values before adopting them.

findings.reason: A69, B69 and C69 establish reported AUC values, but neither integration boundaries nor intended finite-window use are stated. Days 1 and 14 identify dosing occasions, not AUC integration limits. DRQ17 is partially supported and remains UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: The intended AUC endpoint and use, source-defined integration window and time origin, and supporting concentration-time coverage if an observational exposure calculation is pursued.

findings.reason: A66 provides regimen and sampling context but states that concentration curves are in Fig. 3 only and not digitized. No concentration-time records, actual sampling times, verified animal identifiers or sampling structure are supplied on this page. Reported C0 values do not establish observed time-zero samples.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time evidence with sampling times, experimental-unit structure and source provenance if this study is considered for time-course modeling; otherwise retain the reported parameters with their limitations.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, OPEN, needed_at pk: Support for individual PK variability. A66 reports mean ± SE of 3 dogs but no individual records, identifiers or sampling structure. These summaries do not establish interindividual PK variability. A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions remains unestablished; this page does not resolve DRQ09.
findings.needed_material: At PK work, assess verified experimental units and traceable variability evidence, distinguish parameter uncertainty from interindividual variability, and record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from group summaries.

findings.reason: A66 explicitly establishes 120 mg/kg IV once daily for 14 days for this study. It does not state bolus versus infusion, input duration, exact administration times or dose formulation basis. Do not transfer this regimen to independently described dog studies or infer steady state from Day 14.
findings.needed_material: Study-specific administration mode, input duration and dose-basis documentation where required by the intended analysis; preserve the supported repeat-dose schedule independently.
